en: A vintage monochrome postcard view of a landscaped memorial area set in open fields. In the foreground are large stones arranged around a rectangular, monument‑like structure, with paths bordered by low fences leading toward additional stone features and markers in the distance. The printed caption at the top is in German and references a monument connected to battlefield remains. The word "Düppel" appears at the top left.
